scenes.headline: Five questions to ask any company [[pitching a health program to your gym.]]

scenes.title: Ask:
items: Who prescribes, and who holds the clinical record?
Who sets the price and collects payment for the therapy?

scenes.title: Then ask:
items: What happens when a patient finishes their plan?
Who pays to bring new people in?

scenes.headline: The answers tell you whether you're gaining a partner [[or becoming a clinic.]]
